Cancun's median: $233 a night all-in, at 15 hotels for 2 adults, from $99 at Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel to $542 at Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach Cancún All Inclusive Spa & Resort.

Check a Cancun hotel for your dates or check any hotel's price

Google Hotels returned these 18 Cancun hotels, on 63 booking sites; Cancun's median was the 2nd highest of the 25 cities priced that day. Listed prices only: Mayan Monkey Cancún, Solymar Cancun Beach Resort and Oleo Cancun Resort All Inclusive.

By their names, 1 of the 18 is downtown (Centro) and 5 carry "All Inclusive" in the name. Airport of Cancun: Cancun International (CUN). The local currency is the Mexican peso (MXN); the prices here are in US dollars, as a US visitor saw them. Our snapshot does not record whether a price includes meals (an all-inclusive rate) or the room only, so compare what each listing includes before you compare prices.

The booking sites at Cancun hotels

63 sites, 13 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 18, Etrip.net at 16, Vio.com at 16, goseek.com at 15 and Hotels.com at 15. Fewest sites: Solymar Cancun Beach Resort (5); most: SLS Cancun (28, as were 5 others).

Booking.com was lowest at Four Points by Sheraton Cancun Centro of its 18, and 5%+ above another site at 16. Etrip.net was lowest at Mayan Monkey Cancún, Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel and Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach Cancún All Inclusive Spa & Resort of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 10. Vio.com was lowest at Mayan Monkey Cancún, Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel and Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach Cancún All Inclusive Spa & Resort of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 10.

The hotel's own site, at 10 of the 18: lowest at none, a median 36% above the lowest site. Nearest: Four Points by Sheraton Cancun Centro, $106 against $104 on Booking.com, Catchit.com and Bluepillow.com. Farthest: Mayan Monkey Cancún, $234 against $52 on Vio.com, Hostelworld and 3 other sites.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 5, Billabook.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, Vio.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1, goseek.com at 1, klook at 1, Museo Casa Turquesa at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Taxes and fees in Cancun

They added a median of 22.6% ($45 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 19.2% at Hotel Casa Turquesa to 28.6% at Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 3 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Cancun?

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Cancun hotels?

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 28, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price.
